limitations.note: The patch fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed how the FSM exits the match state, reusing the final zero after either a valid one or an invalid cycle where the original logic returns to idle.
The test oracle kept a rolling history of valid bits, so it expected overlapping matches and could not flag the departure from the original post-match transitions.

limitations.note: Exhaustively enumerating eight-cycle streams added little diagnostic value once the oracle encoded the wrong post-match behavior; a few directed checks of the original transitions would have exposed the regression.
